description: Hardware-based authentication mechanisms such as hardware tokens or smart cards are not used for privileged access. This signal indicates that authentication may rely solely on software-based factors.
applicability: Applicable to Level 3 environments requiring strong authentication. Includes hardware security keys, smart cards, and TPM-based authentication.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through authentication method review, hardware token deployment verification, and privileged access assessment.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 - System and Communications Protection
32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
